Koshi MCP Server — local-first retrieval, memory, context, and quality

Usage:
  koshi-mcp                    Run the MCP server on stdio (default).
  koshi-mcp init               Wire a fresh project for Koshi in one command.
                               Run 'koshi-mcp init --help' for flags.
  koshi-mcp config <op>        Inspect/edit mcpServers.koshi.env per client.
                               Run 'koshi-mcp config --help' for details.
  koshi-mcp --list-tools       List every MCP tool this server exposes.
  koshi-mcp --describe <tool>  Show full description + parameters for one tool.
                               Add --json to either flag for machine-readable output.
  koshi-mcp --version, -v      Print the version and exit.
  koshi-mcp --help, -h         Print this help and exit.

Documentation: https://github.com/jsharma1105/Koshi#readme

result.stdout:
koshi-mcp init — wire a fresh project for Koshi in one command.

USAGE
  koshi-mcp init [flags]

WHAT IT DOES
  1. Detects installed MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Copilot CLI).
  2. Registers the koshi MCP server in each client's config (idempotent).
  3. Writes KOSHI_PROJECT_ROOT (and KOSHI_MEMORY_VAULT if a team-yml is
     present) into mcpServers.koshi.env.
  4. Installs personas (.claude/agents/ and ~/.copilot/agents/).
  5. Drops per-ecosystem steering files into the project root:
       AGENTS.md (always), .github/copilot-instructions.md (if Copilot),
       .cursorrules (if .cursor/ exists), .windsurfrules (if .windsurf/ exists).
     Existing files are preserved (Koshi block is appended only if missing).
     Pass --all-templates to install every rule file regardless of detection.
  6. If .koshi-team.yml is present: git-clones (or fast-forward-pulls)
     the declared vault, then registers the declared team.
  7. (Opt-in) With --register-git-template: writes ~/.git-template-koshi/
     and points `git config --global init.templatedir` at it so every
     freshly-cloned repo auto-receives the same steering files.
  8. Prints next-steps + verification commands.

FLAGS
  --client <name>          claude | copilot | all. Repeatable. Defaults to auto-detect.
  --project-root <PATH>    Override the project root (default: walk-up search).
  --non-interactive        Fail rather than prompt. Pair with --yes / --force-personas.
  --yes, -y                Accept the default for any prompt.
  --skip-personas          Don't write persona files.
  --skip-team              Ignore .koshi-team.yml entirely.
  --skip-register          Don't touch mcpServers.koshi.
  --skip-templates         Don't drop AGENTS.md/.cursorrules/.windsurfrules/.github/copilot-instructions.md.
  --all-templates          Install every steering file regardless of which clients are detected.
  --force-personas         Overwrite existing persona files without prompting.
  --force-templates        Overwrite existing steering files instead of appending
[truncated]

result.stdout:
usage: koshi-mcp config <op> [args] --client <claude|copilot|all>
  get KEY --client X            print the value of an env var
  get --all --client X          print every env var as KEY=VALUE
  set KEY=VALUE --client X|all  set an env var (and back up the file)
  set KEY --value-stdin --client X|all  set an env var, value from stdin (avoids shell history)
  unset KEY --client X|all      remove an env var
  apply FILE.env --client X|all merge a dotenv file (KEY=VALUE per line)
